summary: Off-registry HTTP dependency fetches arbitrary code at install
details: package.json declares its sole dependency `cache-format-syntax-tracer` as a bare HTTPS URL to `https://artifacts.creditslib.com/npm/cache-format-syntax-tracer`, a host unrelated to the `@flexmr` publisher scope. The URL has no version pin, no commit SHA, and no integrity hash, so `npm install` fetches whatever tarball the host returns and executes any lifecycle scripts contained in it. The shipped index.js is a one-line re-export of that dependency, meaning the manifest URL is effectively the entire payload: whoever controls artifacts.creditslib.com controls code executed on the installer's machine, and the content at that URL can change at any time without any change to this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
